Standard: The installed APS and emergency power system’s natural (resonant) frequencies do not cause damage to the APS and emergency power system and surrounding installed environment (e.g., APU bay) at all operating conditions or has damping provisions to prevent resonance damage or failure. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct simulation or analysis to verify that the system (compressor, turbine, shafts, gear trains, and other highly stressed parts) is free from vibration stresses that damage the system or other air vehicle systems throughout the operating envelope. Test.
  (1) Ground test: Conduct installed ground testing to show that vibration levels of APS and emergency power system do not exceed qualified vibration levels of APS and emergency power system equipment and other surrounding equipment. Inspection of equipment after test shows the system is free of any damage that could compromise structural integrity and function of equipment. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct instrumented flight testing to show that vibration levels of APS and emergency power system do not exceed qualified vibration levels of APS and emergency power system equipment and other surrounding equipment.
